div.div: خُرْءٌ Human excrement, or ordure: (S, Mgh, * Msb, K;) as also ↓ خَرْءٌ : (Msb, TA:) and sometimes applied to the dung of the dog, and of the field-rat, and of the ant, and of the fly: (TA:) pl. خُرُوْءٌ, (S, Mgh, Msb, K,) which is also a pl. of خَرْءٌ, (Msb, TA,) and خُرْآنٌ, (K,) which is anomalous, and خُرُؤٌ; (TA;) and some say that خِرَآءٌ is a pl. of خَرْءٌ. (Msb, MF.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
